headline: Reliable premixed-blend combination doses and accurate per-vial BAC-water records

changes.title: Prevent premature empty vials when logging premixed-blend combinations
changes.detail: Combination-dose logs now debit the blend's exact physical vial ledger, retain positive source allocations and undo identity, and roll back staged inventory if source confirmation fails.

changes.title: Record confirmed BAC water on the physical vial
changes.detail: Tapping Log Reconstitution confirms the amount shown, including an unchanged default. New standard and blend vial records retain their own exact BAC water and linked preparation history.

changes.title: Safely correct historical vial preparation records
changes.detail: Finished-vial BAC amounts can be explicitly confirmed without reopening stock, changing remaining amounts or fabricating an unknown date. Kit defaults stay labelled unverified when exact historical evidence is absent.

dataImpact: No automatic migration, backfill, repair or overwrite of saved dose history, inventory, current protocols, or browser localStorage (peptide-tracker-html-v1). Future explicit Log Reconstitution actions save the chosen BAC amount on the exact vial and append linked history. Historical Deadpool records marked empty despite missing source allocations are NOT silently restored or modified. Isolated full-app DEMO uses fictional in-memory data with no live writes or sync.
limitations: Existing historical vial records with only kit-level BAC values remain unverified until the user explicitly confirms the actual amount; old dates are never invented.
Existing Deadpool combo records with missing exact vial allocations cannot be safely backfilled automatically; reconciliation requires user review of physical stock and records.
PR #169 multi-source Log Dose changes remain an independent, unmerged draft and are excluded from this release.

Physical iPhone testing: user reported the corrected fictional Deadpool combo and vial-menu/BAC-confirmation scenarios worked. VoiceOver, Dynamic Type and live-data reload were not separately verified.
After merging, primary Cloudflare production source parity must be independently verified; a successful merge or GitHub Pages result alone is insufficient.
